title: English Valley 原创词汇与语言行动支架
audience: 人教版九年级英语学习者；教材页码、具体版本和教师学情复核待完成

languagePolicy.tierMeaning: 教学优先级，不是 CEFR 等级或教材必修清单

tierDefinitions.core: 在主要互动中提供图片、释义和句框，优先能听懂／会用
tierDefinitions.context: 随任务解锁，供比较、记录和协商使用
tierDefinitions.stretch: 可选拓展，教师可替换为简短表达

caseMap.C1: 雨后溪流浑浊：观察、比较、访谈、证据与暂定解释
caseMap.C2: 修理与再用工坊：适合什么用途、检查、维修和维护
caseMap.C3: 夜间灯光：道路使用、节能和自然环境之间的具体权衡

sourcePolicy.sourceIdsSupport: 词义、词性、搭配或语法特征；不证明原创例句中的环境事实
sourcePolicy.examples: 全部为本项目原创虚构场景句，不是来源原句、实测数据或真实访谈
sourcePolicy.thirdPartyRights: 外部网页版权与条款由原权利人保留；本文件不复制词典释义、例句、音频、练习或语料库
sourcePolicy.environmentalEvidence: 环境事实与机制由根项目 ENV01–ENV04 注册项独立审核；本文件不以语言来源替代环境来源

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary — evidence
sources.consulted: FACTS / American Dictionary sections in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 证据义、不可数名词，以及 evidence that 从句；不支持由外观判定健康或因果。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary — litter
sources.consulted: RUBBISH noun and intransitive verb senses in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 公共场所散落废弃物义名词通常不可数；不及物动词表示乱扔垃圾。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary — rubbish
sources.consulted: WASTE noun sense and UK/US usage labels in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 废弃物义不可数；英式 rubbish 与美式 garbage/trash 变体，不将口语贬义用于人物评价。

sources.title: Cambridge Essential British Dictionary — waste
sources.directAccess: this Essential entry was not opened; the general /dictionary/english/waste URL returned 403
sources.consulted: noun unwanted-material sense and verb sense in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 废弃物这一名词义无复数；动词指不合理或过量耗用；不把所有 waste 义项都标为不可数。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary — reuse
sources.directAccess: this /us/ URL was not opened; the /dictionary/english/reuse URL returned 403
sources.consulted: main verb, Intermediate reusable adjective and Business noun sections in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: reuse 动词、reuse 不可数名词、reusable 形容词；词义本身不保证某物适合再次使用。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary — recycle
sources.directAccess: this /us/ URL was not opened; the /dictionary/english/recycle URL returned 403
sources.consulted: main verb senses in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 回收后处理为可再利用材料的义项；词典也收录较宽泛的再次利用义，课件用语需按环保案例明确。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary — compare
sources.directAccess: this /us/ URL was not opened; the /dictionary/english/compare URL returned 403
sources.consulted: EXAMINE DIFFERENCES sense and compare X with Y pattern in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 比较、考察差异及 compare X with Y 搭配；不能将 compare to 一概判错。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary — claim
sources.consulted: SAY verb, STATEMENT countable noun and that-clause patterns in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 声称／主张义动词和可数名词；claim 不自动等于谎言，需判断证据。

sources.title: Cambridge English Grammar Today — Suggest
sources.directAccess: indexed /us/ trailing-dot URL not opened; /grammar/british-grammar/suggest returned 403
sources.consulted: suggest + -ing, that-clause, wh-question word and typical errors in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: 建议的三种补足结构；避免 suggest somebody to do / suggest to do。

sources.title: British Council LearnEnglish — Modals: deductions about the present
sources.consulted: Grammar explanation, must / might / may / could / can't; page lines 22–49; not learner comments
sources.supports: 情态动词表达推断的确信程度；might/could 不确定，must 表达说话者很有把握；不等于科学证明。

sources.title: British Council LearnEnglish — Passives
sources.consulted: Grammar explanation and tense table; page lines 22–57; not learner comments
sources.supports: be + 过去分词及一般现在、一般过去、一般将来被动；用于对象状态／处理记录。

sources.title: British Council LearnEnglish — Present perfect
sources.directAccess: opened successfully; a different grammar-reference/present-perfect URL timed out and is not the registered source
sources.consulted: Grammar explanation, finished time and present result sections; page lines 23–71; not learner comments
sources.supports: have/has + 过去分词、already/yet，与明确结束的过去时间搭配一般过去时的区别。

sources.title: British Council LearnEnglish — Requests, offers and invitations
sources.consulted: Requests and Offers and invitations; page lines 8–40; not learner comments
sources.supports: Could you…? 礼貌请求、Would you like to…? 邀请、Shall I…? 主动提供帮助。

sources.title: British Council LearnEnglish — Conditionals: zero, first and second
sources.consulted: Grammar explanation, first and second conditional; page lines 22–67; not learner comments
sources.supports: 真实可能未来条件与假想条件；本库不用条件句包装未经验证的生态必然结果。

sources.title: Cambridge English Grammar Today — Although or though?
sources.consulted: Although/though subordinate clauses, even though emphasis and punctuation in official search-index excerpt
sources.supports: although/even though 让步从句及完整主句；不叠加 although… but…。

items.exampleEn: Our photographs provide evidence, but they do not tell the whole story.
items.supportScope: 词义、不可数性
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 图片是证据的一部分，不能单靠一张图片确定因果。

items.exampleEn: Do we have evidence that the soil came from this area?
items.supportScope: evidence 后 that 从句结构
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 用问题保留未决状态；evidence that… 不预先保证从句为真。

items.glossZh: 散落在公共场所的垃圾（不可数）
items.exampleEn: We found litter beside the bridge.
items.supportScope: 公共场所垃圾义、不可数性
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 不要把看见 litter 直接写成水浑浊的原因。

items.exampleEn: Please do not litter along the path.
items.supportScope: 不及物动词义
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 这里只使用不及物义，区别于 things litter a place 的及物义。

items.glossZh: 垃圾；废弃物（英式；不可数）
items.exampleEn: What should we do with the rubbish from our workshop?
items.supportScope: 废弃物义、不可数性、英式用语
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 合理语境中的 trash/garbage 也可接受；不把 rubbish 当作评价同伴的词。

items.exampleEn: We sorted the waste after the repair task.
items.supportScope: 不需要的材料这一名词义
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 此条仅覆盖材料义，不宣称 waste 所有名词义都不可数。

items.exampleEn: Leaving lights on in an empty workshop can waste energy.
items.supportScope: 动词耗用义
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 例句限定空工坊，不能推出有人使用的道路也应全部关灯。

items.exampleEn: We plan to reuse this box after checking its condition.
items.supportScope: 及物动词词义
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 再用方案要经过用途和状态检查；词典不是物品安全认证。

items.glossZh: 再次使用这一做法（不可数）
items.exampleEn: Reuse is one option, but we must check whether the object fits the new job.
items.supportScope: 名词词义、不可数性
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 与动词分条，音频录制时需区别词尾 /s/ 与 /z/。

items.exampleEn: This reusable bag is still in good condition.
items.supportScope: 形容词词义
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: reusable 不等于永远完好；例句为虚构场景检查记录。

items.exampleEn: Check the local rules before you recycle this packaging.
items.supportScope: 回收处理义
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 当地接收规则另查；不从词典推出所有包装都可回收。

items.exampleEn: Let's compare the photographs from before and after the rain.
items.supportScope: 比较义
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 拍摄位置和时间需记录，比较结果不自动证明因果。

items.exampleEn: Compare the upstream photograph with the downstream one.
items.supportScope: compare X with Y 搭配
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 不得将 to 变体一概判错；来源仅核查搭配，不核查照片内容。

items.glossZh: 需要审视依据的主张；说法（可数）
items.exampleEn: The claim needs evidence before we accept it.
items.supportScope: STATEMENT 名词义、可数性
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: claim 不等于谎言；可用 idea/statement 作低门槛替代。

items.exampleEn: The poster claims that every old object can be reused. Is that really true?
items.supportScope: SAY 动词义及 that 从句
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 首句刻意呈现待质疑的虚构广告，不是教学结论。

items.exampleEn: We should not claim that the stream is healthy just because the water looks clear.
items.supportScope: claim that 从句结构
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 语法来源不证明水质；该句要求避免仅凭外观下结论。

items.exampleEn: The cloudy water might contain soil from the planting area.
items.supportScope: might 表示不确定推断；后接原形
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 来源支持情态表达，不证明土壤来源；必须继续比较和访谈。

items.exampleEn: The light could be too bright for this quiet corner.
items.supportScope: could 表示不确定推断；后接原形
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 此处不是过去能力；亮度判断仍要结合场景和使用需求。

items.glossZh: 一定／想必……（很有把握的推断）
items.exampleEn: Someone must be inside the workshop: I can hear a person speaking.
items.supportScope: must 表达说话者高确信度的推断
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 这是日常推断示例，不是环境因果证明；不能把 must 推断与义务混为一谈。

items.exampleEn: I suggest checking the base before we use this box.
items.supportScope: suggest + -ing 补足结构
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 避免 suggest to check；检查不等于所有损坏都能修复。

items.exampleEn: I suggest that we ask path users before changing the lighting plan.
items.supportScope: suggest + that 从句
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 从句使用 we ask；不教 suggest someone to do。

items.exampleEn: Could you suggest where we might place the new sign?
items.supportScope: suggest + wh 从句；Could you 礼貌请求
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: where 从句使用陈述语序；提案仍由学生讨论。

items.exampleEn: Each repaired item is checked before it is used again.
items.supportScope: 一般现在时被动结构
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 此句定义模拟工坊流程，不能代替真实维修专业检查。

items.exampleEn: The bridge light was adjusted yesterday.
items.supportScope: 一般过去时被动结构
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 模拟日志须确有此操作；不能用现在完成时配 yesterday。

items.exampleEn: The sign will be checked again next week.
items.supportScope: 一般将来时被动结构
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 需在计划板写责任人和检查时间，不把计划当成完成。

items.exampleEn: We have already compared the two photographs.
items.supportScope: 现在完成时及 already
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 用在已完成且当前仍相关的比较任务，不加明确结束时间。

items.exampleEn: We visited the planting area yesterday.
items.supportScope: 明确结束时间与一般过去时
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 来源支持时态选择；具体经历是原创虚构任务日志。

items.exampleEn: We have not checked the handle yet.
items.supportScope: 现在完成时否定及 yet
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 鼓励承认尚未检查，避免为了通关假报完成。

items.exampleEn: Could you explain what happened before the rain, please?
items.supportScope: Could you + 原形的礼貌请求
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 这里只声称来源核验请求框架，完整访谈句由项目原创。

items.headword: Would you like to + base verb …?
items.exampleEn: Would you like to join our evening path check?
items.supportScope: Would you like to 邀请结构
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 邀请保留对方选择，不以强制口号替代沟通。

items.exampleEn: Shall I record your idea on the planning board?
items.supportScope: Shall I 主动提供帮助
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 此条为 offer，不等于命令；接受符合语境的其他自然表达。

items.exampleEn: If it rains tomorrow, we will compare the two locations again.
items.supportScope: 第一条件句：真实可能的未来
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 只承诺再次观察，不承诺一项措施后水体必然恢复。

items.exampleEn: If we had more time, we would test another lighting plan.
items.supportScope: 第二条件句：假想条件
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 作为可选拓展；had 在此表达假想，不是在叙述过去拥有时间。

items.glossZh: 虽然……，但是……（英语不用双连词）
items.exampleEn: Although this path is quiet, some people still use it at night.
items.supportScope: although 让步从句及主从句连接
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 英文主句不再加 but；安静不等于无人使用。

items.glossZh: 尽管……，仍然……（强调已知事实）
items.exampleEn: Even though the box looks strong, we still need to check its base.
items.supportScope: even though 强调已承认事实的让步
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 此处是已观察到的外观，不与假设条件 even if 混同。

items.headword: At first …, but I have now …
items.glossZh: 起初……，但现在我已……（修正看法）
items.exampleEn: At first, I blamed the bottles, but I have now changed my view.
items.supportScope: 已结束的过去看法与当前相关的现在完成时；整句衔接为原创
items.exampleVerification: editorial_review_against_cited_feature; not externally validated or classroom piloted
items.editorialNote: 不把承认错误扣成失败；来源仅支持时态对照，不将自写框架冒充来源原句。
